description: This Java class provides database connection management and query execution utilities for interacting with a MySQL database. It includes methods for creating a singleton JDBC connection, executing raw and parameterized SQL queries, and managing prepared statements with proper parameter binding. The class also reads database configuration from environment variables and contains legacy methods for backward compatibility.

classes.name: webDB
classes.description: A utility class for managing a singleton JDBC connection and executing SQL queries, including legacy and parameterized methods, with configuration driven by environment variables.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates a singleton JDBC connection if one does not already exist, reading connection parameters from environment variables.

methods.name: executeSearch
methods.description: Legacy method that executes a raw SQL query string and returns a ResultSet.

methods.name: executeIUD
methods.description: Legacy method that executes a raw SQL insert/update/delete statement and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the shared JDBC connection, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: executeSearch
methods.description: Executes a parameterized SELECT query using PreparedStatement with bound parameters.

methods.name: executeIUD
methods.description: Executes a parameterized INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE query using PreparedStatement with bound parameters.

methods.name: bindParams
methods.description: Binds the provided parameters to the PreparedStatement placeholders.

methods.name: envOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable value or returns a default if not set or blank.
